# d-stellar

d-stellar is an LGBTQ+-friendly cookie shop and trans safe space in Hipódromo
Condesa, Mexico City. It was founded in 2024 by Hernán Castilla and Eduardo
Hernández under "The Sweet Universe Company." d-stellar sells gourmet
author-style cookies ("galletas de autor") and signature coffee/drinks, with
a full menu that rotates every month (cookies, signature drinks, and a
caffeine-free section all change monthly). d-stellar also hosts community
events (drag viewing parties, book presentations, cookie tastings) and rents
its space for private events.

## About

- Name: d-stellar (legal name: d-stellar — by The Sweet Universe Company)
- Founded: 2024, by Hernán Castilla and Eduardo Hernández
- Category: Cookie shop / café (bakery, coffee, desserts)
- Address: Av. Nuevo León 217, Hipódromo Condesa, Cuauhtémoc, 06100, Ciudad
  de México, Mexico — inside Pabellón Nuevo León (shared hallway entrance)
- Hours: Mon/Thu/Sat/Sun 11:00–19:00, Tue 14:00–19:00, Wed/Fri 12:00–19:00
- Contact: WhatsApp only for real-time contact (no in-store cell signal for
  calls) — see https://www.d-stellar.co for the current number
- Website: https://www.d-stellar.co (bilingual, Spanish default, /en for
  English). Note: d-stellar.com is an old, unrelated legacy store — the
  real site is the .co domain.
- Social: Instagram and TikTok @dstellarmx, Facebook and LinkedIn under
  d-stellar

## Key facts

- d-stellar is pet friendly, has Wi-Fi, dine-in and takeaway (no delivery).
- The menu rotates every month with new flavors; vegan options are included
  in the rotation every month.
- Pickup orders are placed online, confirmed via WhatsApp, and paid online
  in advance (Mercado Pago) — there is no delivery service.
- d-stellar positions itself explicitly as a trans safe space and an
  LGBTQ+-friendly business — this is core to the brand identity, not a
  marketing campaign.
- As of October 2026, d-stellar has a 5.0-star average rating from 156
  Google reviews.
- Press coverage includes El Economista, Yahoo Noticias, Nómada Capital,
  and other Mexican business/lifestyle/LGBTQ+ outlets — full list at
  https://www.d-stellar.co/press.
- Full FAQ (location, hours, parking, transit, pickup, events) at
  https://www.d-stellar.co/faq.
